title: What is the longest jump for these two pairs of treasures?
description: The Jump Jackpot game is played again with treasures on thirty and fifty, and then on twenty eight and forty two. For each pair the jump sizes that land on each treasure are listed, and the longest size on both lists is picked. Keeko's doubt, the biggest size on the lists, is tested on the number line.
teaching_notes: One idea: the longest jump that lands on two treasures is the largest number on both factor lists. Watch for students who take the biggest number on the lists instead of the biggest shared number.

source: Treasures are on 30 and 50. Find the longest jump from 0 tha
video_script.why: The child has met one pair of treasures and now repeats the method on two pairs with longer factor lists, where a factor is easy to miss.
video_script.substitution: A jump lands on a treasure exactly when its size is a factor of the treasure, so the longest jump for two treasures is their largest shared factor.
video_script.anchor: A number line from zero with treasures on thirty and fifty, and a jumper who picks one jump size.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko picks the biggest size on the lists, fifty. A jump of fifty lands on fifty but never on thirty, so it is not on both lists.
video_script.payoff_line: The longest jump is ten for the first pair, and fourteen for the second pair.

final_answer.spoken: ten for thirty and fifty, and fourteen for twenty eight and forty two

names.{{NAME_5}}: places treasures on numbers in the Jump Jackpot game
names.{{NAME_2}}: chooses a jump size in the Jump Jackpot game

maths_rules: Jump sizes landing on 50: 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50 (1 x 50, 2 x 25, 5 x 10).
Common sizes for 30 and 50: 1, 2, 5, 10. Longest is 10.
Jump sizes landing on 28: 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, 28 (1 x 28, 2 x 14, 4 x 7).
Common sizes for 28 and 42: 1, 2, 7, 14. Longest is 14.
Slip: a jump of 50 lands on 50 but jumps over 30, since 50 is not a factor of 30.
video_script.design: One idea: the longest shared jump is the largest number on both factor lists. Assumes the factor method of the earlier jump video. Wrong idea: the biggest size on the lists. The number line stays all video.
